workout.session_type: DAY D - Upper (pull emphasis) - 80 MIN TARGET

exercises.name: BLOCK 1 PAIR - Lat Pulldown + DB Bench Press
exercises.detail: Lat Pulldown 135 lb x 8-10, then straight into DB Bench Press 70 lb x 10. 3 rounds. Bench is DELIBERATELY 70 today, not 80 - it is the antagonist filler on a pull day, not the lead lift. Do not chase 80.

exercises.name: BLOCK 1 PAIR - Seated Cable Row + DB Shoulder Press
exercises.detail: Seated Cable Row 165 lb x 10-12 (UP from 150 - you went 3x12 clean last time), then straight into DB Shoulder Press 50 lb x 10. 3 rounds. Shoulder press is 50 today, not 60 - 60 stays the lead on press day only.

exercises.name: BLOCK 2 PAIR - Face Pulls + Hammer Curl
exercises.detail: Face Pulls 80 lb x 15 (UP from 70 - all 3 sets were clean), then straight into Hammer Curl 30 lb x 10. 3 rounds. If round 2 arms are cooked, drop curls to 25 and keep the reps - that worked last time.

exercises.name: BLOCK 3 - Core Circuit
exercises.detail: 2 rounds: Pallof Press 25 lb x 12/side, Hanging Knee Raise x 12, Dead Bugs x 24

exercises.name: FINISHER - Incline Walk (YOUR CALL ON DURATION)
exercises.detail: Target 10-12 min, but duration is yours - log whatever you actually do. HARD RULE after Saturday: keep HR under 140 and stop if you feel lightheaded. Lightheaded is not a push-through signal. Drop speed or incline to stay under the cap rather than toughing it out. Note your HR range and minutes in the box.
